II. Pitching Signal Terms

III. Hitting Signal Terms

Mean exit velocity on tracked batted-ball events.
Barrel-like %
Share of batted balls in the DiamondSignals barrel-like bucket.
EV Burst
A recent jump in average exit velocity versus baseline.
